source: single-page UWP sample (FaceDetection.MainPage) — camera preview + face detection

features.name: CameraFaceDetection

controls.name: PhotoButton
controls.role: capture a photo (enabled once camera initialized)

controls.name: VideoButton
controls.role: start/stop video recording (enabled once camera initialized)

controls.name: FaceDetectionButton
controls.role: toggle face detection on/off (enabled once camera initialized)

features.notes: All three buttons start IsEnabled=False and only enable after a camera device is found and MediaCapture initializes. On a machine with no camera the buttons remain disabled. This is hardware-gated behavior in the original UWP app.
